name: Southwest Asian and North African Center
description: The Southwest Asian and North African (SWANA) Center is Sacramento State's center for SWANA students, offering services, programs, and ways to meet the team and get involved.

name: Iranian and Middle Eastern Studies Center
description: The mission of the Iranian and Middle Eastern Studies Center (IMESC) is to foster a better understanding of the peoples, culture, and politics of Iran and the Middle East in the Greater Sacramento region and Northern California.

name: Asian Pacific Islander Desi American Student Center
description: The Asian Pacific Islander Desi American (APIDA) Student Center connects students with its own resources as well as campus programs and community partners that support Asian Pacific Islander Desi American students.
supportServices: Individual assistance and referrals to on and off-campus resources
College skills coaching: time management, organization, study, and goal setting
Referral to graduate school and research opportunities
Information and workshops about financial aid and student accounts policies and processes
Scholarship search/application support including proofreading essays/resumes and providing recommendation letters

name: Martin Luther King Jr. Center
description: The MLK Center is a central hub for the exploration of African American heritage and culture. The overall Center is designed to foster an ethos of success that permeates the scholarly experience, the community, and the world by setting a tone of change and lifelong improvement that inspires and fulfills the dream of Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.
supportServices: Partner with local businesses and organizations
Achieve a stronger sense of belonging in the Campus Community

name: Crisis Assistance & Resource Education Support (CARES)
description: The Sacramento State Crisis Assistance & Resource Education Support (CARES) office provides support to students who are having a difficult time with their basic needs like finances, food, and counseling.
supportServices: Academic case management & faculty liaison support
Basic needs emergency grant and non-qualified scholarships

name: Student Health, Counseling, & Wellness Services
description: Student Health, Counseling, & Wellness Services (SHCWS) offers urgent care, primary care, preventive services, wellness education, violence support services, and mental health services to the Sacramento State campus community.

name: Multi-Cultural Center
description: At the Multi-Cultural Center, our mission is to foster an empowered campus that is committed to building bridges, promoting social justice, honoring diverse perspectives, and advancing social awareness and cross-cultural understanding.
supportServices: Connections to other support programs on campus
